checks.name: 6등급 공모펀드 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fund_master WHERE TRY_CAST(drv_risk_grade AS INT) = 6

checks.name: 월배당(12회) 상장중 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_pay_cnt AS DOUBLE) >= 12 AND TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE) > 0
